company.description: 83 Sciences is an artificial intelligence and scientific research software company that develops an AI-native materials discovery platform powered by unpublished experimental data. The company helps research laboratories transform discarded and unstructured experimental data into searchable scientific knowledge, enabling researchers to uncover new insights, accelerate materials discovery, and increase research output. Its platform is designed to preserve institutional knowledge while turning failed and unpublished experiments into valuable scientific assets. The system ingests data from lab notebooks, voice notes, instrument outputs, and characterization data, creating a structured, queryable record of experimental history that enables researchers to analyze prior work, identify optimized process conditions, and generate papers, patents, and commercialization opportunities.
